name: Vighnahar Temple, Ozar
summary: Ozar’s Vighnahar is the obstacle-removing Ganesha of the Ashtavinayak set.
mythology: Vighnahar Temple, Ozar at Ozar, Pune district, Maharashtra is dedicated to Lord Ganesha (Vighneshwar / Vighnahar), known especially for Ashtavinayak — remover of obstacles. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather.
